Review Title: Just amazing. There flights and service are outstanding.
Review Text:
These guys were amazing.
From the customer service to the actual tour, these guys just had it going on.
As the 1st day in Talkeetna was overcast and snowing, we rebooked our flight to our last day in Talkeetna. The team were very helpful in this.
As we had finished a dog mushing tour on our second day, the weather was superb and you could see the 3 mountains from town.
Luckily for us, we walked to airport and asked if we could get on the flight from our rebooked ticket the next day and they managed to get us on the flight that day. The team at the airport base were super helpful in this.
The flight was amazing. We were lucky enough to see all three mountains in the one flight and the scenery was spectacular. Its hard to put into words. The only issue we had was another companies plane was on the glacier runway and we couldn't land. Our pilot Jack tried to wait a few minutes and took a quick lap around the area to come back and see if we could get down but it wasn't safe so we couldn't land and then we flew back to base. When talking to the team at the airport, we said we had an amazing experience and a shame we missed the landing. You don't have to pay for that part as well if you didn't get it. As we were buying some merchandise from the shop, the staff came back to us and asked us if we wanted to jump on the next flight, for free, and only pay for the landing if we got it. We jumped at the chance. We got the same pilot Jack again for our next flight. He was excellent and explained and answers for questions when asked over the radio. Luckily, we got a glacier landing on this flight.
It was an amazing experience and well worth the money. Luckily for us we got two flights for the price of the one.
I cant thank the team at K2 aviation for the help they gave us. There customer service was amazing, just like the service they provide.
I would thoroughly recommend K2 aviation for a Denali flight experience. Its a must do when in Talkeetna

Review Title: Great way to see Denali and surroundings
Review Text: Excellent experience! (K2 Grand Tour, without glacier landing) The views were totally amazing + our pilot was skilled, knowledgeable, and provided just the right amount of narration/explanation during the flight. We were very lucky with particularly clear weather, but the terrain, and the altitudes at which you see it, are very varied, so I'd guess that it will be remarkable even in less-than-perfect conditions . The pilots have discretion about the exact route they fly, so they can take best advantage of whatever is happening on the day you fly. We recommend leaving an empty day the day after your scheduled flight, if that's possible, so that in the rare event that no flights can go out on your day, you can stay over and try again the next day. In any case, the train trip to Talkeetna is very pleasant and scenic, and the town itself is...cute. A highlight of our Alaska trip (tied with the Kenai fjords boat tour).

Last minute the Summit tour was cancelled due to high winds, so we sort-of reluctantly rebooked to the Denali Grand Tour since it would be the best option we could get. The Grand Tour was utterly spectacular. I was lucky enough to ride copilot, our pilot was fantastic and answered all of my nerdy airplane questions, and for 90 minutes we got to see the staggering views of Denali and the surrounding rivers, glaciers, and sister mountains up close and personal with INSANE visibility. We climbed to a total of 12.3kft and could see each peak in an incredibly personal and in-your-face manner as we weaved in-and-out through the peaks and valleys.

90 minutes came and went so fast. Yes this can seem expensive to most, but damnit, do it! You will not regret it for a minute and you’ll have unreal photos to reflect on for the rest of your life.

We are still in awe. Thank for the mesmerizing experience, K2! Just keep flying!

Review Text:
Booked this with my father who was up in Alaska visiting me. We originally booked the Grand Denali with glacier landing, and was told we'd be on a Turbine Otter-- which made sense, given they're the majority of K2 and every other Talkeetna tour operator's fleet, as they make excellent flight seeing planes due to their high wings and single engine. The booking was pricey, especially when an entire 185 could have been chartered for the same money (and we'd have had seats to spare), but being able to land on the glacier was worth it, we thought.

When we arrived we learned the glacier landing was scrubbed due to the warm weather. Not much to be done about that-- we were disappointed but in no way upset about K2 for it. And besides, the weather was as clear and sunny as I have ever seen Denali, and smoke from the local wildfires had shifted out of the area, setting up K2 with the opportunity to give an absolutely amazing trip.

Instead, they blew it. We were ushered not to an Otter but a Piper Navajo, whose twin engines and low wings make it utterly horrible for a flight seeing plane-- probably why neither Talkeetna Air Taxi nor Sheldon Air Service across the taxiway from K2 have anything like it in their fleet. It is, however, a bit cheaper to operate than an Otterof which there were about 4 on the ramp at K2 when we departed. The picture attached shows the view out my window. I spent the entire flight with them obstructing the views and making pictures more difficult.

I won't be bringing any other visitors back to K2. Taking a scenic around Denali is certainly an experience, but K2 absolutely blew it. I'll be taking future visitors elsewhere.

Review Title: Stunning Views, Wonderful pilot, Smooth Flight
Review Text:
I could not recommend taking a K2 flying tour more. It was the highlight of our trip to Alaska and one of the most unforgettable experiences I've ever had.

K2 watched the weather carefully and made sure we went up at a time when the viewing would be good. We really appreciated their diligence about the weather to ensure a good viewing experience. Given the potentially flexible nature of the flight time, I would recommend planning only activities that can be rescheduled on the same day as your flight tour. We just did a local hike that day, so it was easy to flop our schedules to accommodate the flight time change. We also ended up on a better tour without paying extra since our rescheduled time was to go with others who had booked a longer tour.

The plane itself was comfortable and offered great views from every seat. Our pilot made the experience extra special by sharing information about everything we were seeing as well as happily answering any questions we had. He was also diligent about making sure everyone on both sides of the plane got to enjoy views of the best sights.

The one complaint I would have is that we were confused about being picked up for our flight. When we signed up, the form asked for a pick-up location and gave us a pickup time, but we were actually expected to get there ourselves. Getting there wasn't an issue, but the confusion about what we were supposed to do was frustrating. They also didn't call us when they knew our flight would be rescheduled. They were just going to wait for us to check in at the location to tell us. Luckily, our lodging owner called over there for some other customers and found out that they wouldn't be flying until the afternoon and let us know. We then called and we able to reschedule and clarify the pickup situation. This was frustrating at the time, but the experience was so wonderful, I am not docking them any rating points. I would just suggest that you call before you head there to check on the weather and pickup situation.
